_comment: Seed fixture for the related-tickets-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000005540 (Phase 4 free-htmx port — second port after
activity-log-htmx, MR !2334 / ka-0000004584). Strategy A — port-then-
soak: lives alongside the Go-coded `related-tickets` slug rather than
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `related-tickets` renderer at
id/kind/title/url/state. The htmx template intentionally does NOT
construct action buttons (those need the Go-side OpenJiraAction /
OpenMRAction helpers); button rendering is a parity gap documented in
the port doc and in TestRelatedTicketsParity.

fields.template_source:
{{- $tickets := index .Payload "tickets" -}} {{if $tickets}}
    {{range $tickets}}
  • {{if .kind}}{{.kind}}{{end}} {{if .id}}{{.id}}{{end}} {{if .title}}{{.title}}{{end}} {{if .state}}{{.state}}{{end}}
    • {{end}}
{{else}}

No related tickets.

{{end}}
